findings.claim: Q2 FY2026 revenue was $1.584B, up 24.2% YoY; non-GAAP EPS $2.11, up 27.9% YoY.
findings.source: Cadence Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results (Business Wire via Morningstar); 8-K Ex.99.1 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000813672/000081367226000089/cdns07272026ex9901.htm

findings.claim: IP revenue grew more than 40% YoY in Q2 FY2026, driven by AI, HPC and advanced-node activity.
findings.source: Futurum, 'Cadence Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Agentic AI and Record Backlog' https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/ ; BigGo Finance CDNS Q2 2026 earnings call https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_CDNS_2026-07-27

findings.claim: System Design and Analysis (SD&A) revenue rose 37% YoY in Q2 FY2026.
findings.source: Futurum, 'Cadence Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Agentic AI and Record Backlog' https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/ ; BigGo Finance https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_CDNS_2026-07-27

findings.claim: Core EDA grew 18% YoY in Q2 FY2026, attributed by the source to AI-enhanced digital implementation and sign-off tools; every product group posted double-digit growth.
findings.source: BigGo Finance, CDNS Q2 2026 earnings call https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_CDNS_2026-07-27 ; Futurum https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/

findings.claim: Hardware (Palladium Z3 / Protium X3) delivered another record quarter in Q2 FY2026 and added 12 new logos; the source says AI and HPC customers treat hardware-assisted verification as a strategic capacity layer.
findings.source: BigGo Finance, CDNS Q2 2026 earnings call https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_CDNS_2026-07-27 ; Futurum https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/

findings.claim: Backlog reached a record $8.1B (up 27%), with $4.2B expected to convert to revenue within 12 months.
findings.source: Futurum, 'Cadence Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Agentic AI and Record Backlog' https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/

findings.claim: FY2026 guidance was raised to revenue of $6.26B-$6.34B (about 19% growth at midpoint), non-GAAP EPS $8.05-$8.15, non-GAAP operating margin 43.75%-44.75%, operating cash flow about $2B.
findings.source: Futurum, 'Cadence Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Agentic AI and Record Backlog' https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/

findings.claim: Company guidance assumes export-control exposure stays broadly unchanged; the article does not disclose China revenue share.
findings.source: Futurum, 'Cadence Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Agentic AI and Record Backlog' https://futurumgroup.com/insights/cadence-q2-fy-2026-earnings-climb-on-agentic-ai-and-record-backlog/

note: Segments follow Cadence's reported product groups (Core EDA, IP, SD&A, hardware); section 3 of the DD was not available to this agent.
